Coverage: climate.discomap.eea.europa.eu. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Percentage of Urban Morphological Zones (UMZ) potentially exposed to r; Ratio of percentage area at flood risk between regions in Q5 (top 20%); Percentage of educational facilities in potential flood-prone areas at; Percentage of healthcare services in potential flood-prone areas at ci. Formats seen: WMS, SHP, GDB. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eea-sdi.
